description: Na₂LiAlF₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.66 Å. Li is bonded to six F atoms to form LiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-28°. There are a spread of Li-F bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.09 Å. Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-28°. There are four shorter (1.83 Å) and two longer (1.84 Å) Al-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one Al atom to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₂LiAl tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Li, and one Al atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Li, and one Al atom.
